subject: Renewal forecast confirmation and churn indicators for Acme Corp
messages:
From: Sarah Park <sarah.park@acme.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Aug 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning — data request and timing

Hi Irene,

We’re starting our renewal planning for the platform (renewal window in mid-September) and I need a quick set of confirmations from your side so procurement can prep the PO. Can you confirm:

- Current committed ARR and any add-ons on the account?
- Latest 90-day usage trends (seats, tokens) and any notable drops?
- Proposed effective date and invoice cadence (annual vs. monthly)?

If you can attach the most recent usage snapshot and any supporting renewal evidence, that would be great. Goal is to have a signed PO drafted by 9/12.

Thanks — happy to sync quickly if easier.

Sarah Park
Head of Cloud Ops, Acme Corp
procurement@acme.com

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Park <sarah.park@acme.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 28 Aug 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — data request and timing

Sarah — thanks for the heads up. Attaching the files below: renewal-evidence_acme_Q3.xlsx and prod-usage-snapshot_acme_aug2028.pdf. Quick summary inline so procurement has what they need: 

- Committed ARR (current contract): $1,200,000 annual.
- Add-ons in last 12 months: 2x Dedicated LLM seats (professional services credits applied).
- 90-day usage trend: net -18% month-over-month in token consumption for the Primary BU (details in PDF). Usage dip correlates with a re-org (two teams consolidated), not feature degradation.
- Proposed effective date: 2028-10-01 (customer prefers aligning to fiscal Q4). Invoice cadence: Redwood default is annual; customer indicated preference for annual but procurement will confirm.

Flagging churn signal: the usage reduction triggers our "drop-in-usage" alert — classifying current churn-risk as Medium-High until we confirm seat count and timeline for re-activation.

Action items I recommend now:
1) Procurement to confirm final seat counts and whether any seats will be retired (Sarah).
2) Finance (Naomi) to confirm invoicing cadence & whether a provisional credit is required if seat counts drop more than 20%.
3) CS (Marissa) to schedule a product health check with the Primary BU to surface adoption blockers.

Sarah — when you have PO guidance please forward. If helpful we can do a 20-minute sync tomorrow.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: renewal-evidence_acme_Q3.xlsx (spreadsheet), prod-usage-snapshot_acme_aug2028.pdf (report)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sarah Park <sarah.park@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Aug 2028 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — data request and timing

Thanks Irene — I reviewed the attached workbook. A couple finance notes and a short ask for procurement: 

- If Acme reduces licensed seats by >20% vs. current committed baseline, our standard approach is to (a) pro-rate the remainder of the term and (b) apply a one-time adjustment to ARR. We can outline options to soften impact (credit, amortized refund) if close collaboration is desired.
- Invoice cadence: Naomi prefers annual invoicing for simplicity, but open to monthly if procurement requires.

Sarah, can you confirm whether procurement expects a net-new PO or a renewal amendment? Also please confirm billing contact for the PO and whether the PO needs to reference SOW/PS items. HubSpot record attached for reference: https://hubspot.redwood.example/record/ACME-3245

If we classify this as "at-risk" renewal based on usage, finance will hold a small buffer for recognition — we'll coordinate once seat counts are confirmed.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Park <sarah.park@acme.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — data request and timing

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few confirmations from procurement side: 

- We will proceed with a renewal amendment (no net-new PO) to reflect updated seat counts and a minor pricing adjustment.
- Billing contact: accounts-payable@acme.com.
- The Primary BU did consolidate and expects to scale back 15% of active seats over the next 60 days; they plan to re-evaluate in the next quarter.

Request: given the timing and the 15% planned reduction, could Redwood consider a one-time concession (we're requesting ~10% off list for this renewal) to maintain continuity while our BU completes restructuring? If you can send an updated renewal amendment draft (DocuSign link would be ideal) we can move quickly.

Sarah Park
Head of Cloud Ops, Acme Corp

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 30 Aug 2028 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — data request and timing

Thanks all — quick internal summary and next steps so we don't lose momentum. Marking current renewal risk as "Moderate-High" based on the usage dip and planned 15% seat reduction: we should treat this as a time-sensitive retention opportunity.

Owners and dates:
- Marissa (CS): schedule Primary BU health + adoption call by 2028-09-04.
- Naomi (Finance): prepare two invoice scenarios (annual vs. monthly) and an optional credit structure for up to 10% concession by 2028-09-05.
- Irene (RevOps): draft renewal amendment (include AS-IS ARR, proposed adjusted seat counts, and optional 10% concession line) and share DocuSign link by 2028-09-06.

Risk mitigation notes:
- CS to document feature usage gaps and enablement plan during the health call; if structural (not product) it's lower risk for attrition.
- Finance to flag revenue recognition impact if seats decline >20% before effective date.

Attachments referenced: renewal-evidence_acme_Q3.xlsx, prod-usage-snapshot_acme_aug2028.pdf

Irene Choi
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
